test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statement: "Students who regularly engage in reading outside the syllabus tend to perform better in problem-solving."

Conclusions:

I. Problem-solving ability is enhanced by reading beyond the syllabus.

II. Only students who read outside the syllabus excel academically.
solution:
**Statement:** Students who regularly engage in reading outside the syllabus tend to perform better in problem-solving.

**Conclusion I:** Problem-solving ability is enhanced by reading beyond the syllabus. ⇒ The statement clearly mentions that students who read outside the syllabus tend to perform better in problem-solving. Hence, this conclusion follows.

**Conclusion II:** Only students who read outside the syllabus excel academically. ⇒ The statement talks only about better performance in problem-solving and does not mention that only such students excel academically. Hence, this conclusion does not follow.

Hence, only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
